name: Purdue Village Administration Building
description: The Purdue Village Administration Building, formerly the Married Student Housing Administration Building, provided 23,000 gross square feet of new space for the Married Student Housing. The building housed the Married Student Housing administrative offices, storage areas for furniture, plumbing fixtures, electrical supplies, appliances, paint, plaster, and cleaning equipment; and storage/service area for grounds maintenance. The facility also provided storage space for the Residence Halls.
